statements.mock_in_production: The Telegram mock transport is gated by APP_ENV and unit-tested to never select mock in production ('selectTransport: production with TELEGRAM_MOCK=1 → STILL disabled'; 'production without token → disabled, never silent drop'). In production the disabled-transport fallback suppresses jobs (no_channel / transport_disabled) instead of dropping them silently. Demo seed data is flagged is_demo=true and excluded from analytics/directory; db:seed and db:reset refuse to run when APP_ENV=production.
